title: My Nephew Took My $92K For His MBA, Dubbed It A Gift. So I Let The Court Seize His Paycheck
description: After my nephew called my $92,000 MBA funding a gift, I sued for promissory estoppel and won a $340,000 judgment. Now his garnished wages fund a free financial clinic where clients drink from mugs that honor my sacrifice, and he volunteers wearing a tie that says 'Fiduciary Fraudster.' Some promises can't be broken without a receipt. #PromissoryEstoppel #FamilyBetrayal #FinancialRevenge
thumb_text: HE CALLED IT A GIFT, NOW HE WEARS THE TIE
pinned_comment: If your nephew took $92,000 for his MBA and called it a gift, would you have taken him to court like I did? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: HE LANDED A $250K JOB AND SAID HE OWED ME NOTHING
